Cyprus arrests man suspected of spying for Iran on UK airbase

Authorities in Cyprus have arrested a British-Azerbaijani national, identified as Rashad Sultanov, on suspicion of spying for Iran. Sultanov is accused of conducting hostile surveillance and passing information to Iran's Revolutionary Guards. The alleged spying targeted a British airbase located on the Mediterranean island. Britain has requested Cyprus to extradite Sultanov to face charges.
